title: Data Engineer
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Selatan, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure that powers our analytics, machine learning, and operational systems. You will work closely with software engineers, and business stakeholders to turn raw, complex data into reliable, production-ready pipelines and datasets. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in data quality, reliability, and engineering excellence.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

Pipeline Design & Data Ingestion
• Design and build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for both batch and real-time processing, ensuring high throughput and fault tolerance.
• Ingest and process high-frequency data from diverse sources including REST/GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, IoT/sensor streams, and event queues.
• Transform raw, messy, and heterogeneous data into clean, validated, and production-ready datasets for downstream consumers.
• Architect and maintain data lake and data warehouse structures, including partitioning strategies, schema evolution, and data versioning.
• Evaluate, select, and integrate appropriate data tools and frameworks based on project requirements and scale.
ML & Analytics Support
• Support and deploy machine learning-ready pipelines, including feature engineering, data preprocessing, and preparation of model inputs and training datasets.
• Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML workflows, ensuring reproducibility and scalability of pipelines.
• Build and maintain feature stores and data marts that support analytical dashboards, reporting, and model serving.
• Develop and maintain data catalogues and metadata management systems to improve data discoverability and lineage.

Data Quality & Reliability
• Implement comprehensive data quality checks, validation frameworks, and alerting mechanisms across all pipelines.
• Monitor pipeline health, throughput, and latency; proactively diagnose and resolve data issues before they impact downstream systems.
• Design for scalability and reliability in production, applying best practices for idempotency, retry logic, and graceful failure handling.
• Conduct root cause analysis on data incidents and implement corrective and preventive measures.
Infrastructure & Orchestration
• Deploy and manage pipeline orchestration using tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
• Work with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) to provision and manage data infrastructure including storage, compute, and streaming services.
• Implement CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including automated testing, version control, and deployment pipelines.
• Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to containerize and deploy data workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

Kualifikasi:
Required Experience :
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related discipline.
• 3–5 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in production environments.
• Proven track record working with imperfect, noisy, and real-world data at scale.
• Experience with time-series or IoT data ingestion and processing is highly valued.
• Experience in a fintech, banking, SaaS, or high-availability production environment is strongly preferred.
• Exposure to agile development practices and cross-functional team collaboration.

Required Skills :
Core Engineering
• Strong proficiency in Python for data engineering tasks including data manipulation, pipeline scripting, and automation.
• Advanced SQL skills: query optimization, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategies, and working with large datasets.
• Solid understanding of data modelling concepts including star/snowflake schemas, dimensional modelling, and normalization.
• Experience with data serialization formats: JSON, Avro, Parquet, ORC, and Protobuf.

Pipeline & Streaming Tools
• Proven experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster for scheduling and dependency management.
• Exposure to streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, or AWS Kinesis for real-time data processing.
• Familiarity with ETL/ELT frameworks such as dbt, Spark, or Beam.
• Experience with change data capture (CDC) patterns and tools (e.g., Debezium) is an advantage.

Cloud & Infrastructure
• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: Amazon Web Services (S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda), Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub), or Microsoft Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, Event Hubs).
• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
• Working knowledge of containerization with Docker; experience with Kubernetes is a plus.
• Understanding of data lake architectures (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi).

Machine Learning Integration
• Experience with machine learning workflows including feature engineering, data preprocessing pipelines, and integration with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, or similar).
• Familiarity with MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar ML lifecycle management tools is an advantage.
• Ability to work closely with data scientists to translate model requirements into scalable, production-grade data pipelines.

Soft Skills :
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose complex data issues in distributed systems under pressure.
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to produce clear technical documentation and present findings to stakeholders.
• Collaborative and proactive team player with experience working across data science, engineering, and product functions.
• Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over data quality and pipeline reliability.
• Comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly changing requirements in a fast-paced environment.

Working Environment
• Join a young and dynamic team in an international, professional, English-speaking environment.
• Work with cutting-edge data technologies and modern cloud platforms.
• Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and product teams on high-impact, large-scale projects.
• Open culture where people are valued, trusted, and empowered to do great things.

description_text:
Computer Vision Engineer

Kualifikasi:
Overview
We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer who can assess the technical feasibility of offline (on-device / edge) image recognition solutions, build and deploy YOLO-based detection models end-to-end, and also work with cloud-based computer vision services such as AWS Rekognition. Prior hands-on experience taking an offline model from research to production deployment is highly valued.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct technical feasibility assessments for offline image recognition needs: architecture selection, dataset size, compute/hardware requirements (edge device, GPU/CPU), latency, and storage constraints before development begins.
Design, train, and optimize image recognition / object detection models based on YOLO that can run fully offline (on-device/edge, no dependency on internet/cloud connectivity).
Perform data preparation, annotation, augmentation, and model evaluation (precision, recall, mAP, etc.).
Optimize models for deployment (quantization, pruning, conversion to lightweight formats such as ONNX / TensorRT / TFLite) so they run efficiently on target devices.
Handle end-to-end deployment of computer vision models to production/edge devices, including post-deployment monitoring and maintenance.
Explore and implement cloud-based computer vision / image recognition solutions (e.g., AWS Rekognition, Azure Computer Vision, Google Vision AI) as alternatives or complements to offline solutions.
Provide trade-off recommendations between offline (custom model) and cloud-based (managed service) solutions based on business needs, cost, data privacy, and infrastructure conditions.
Collaborate with product/engineering teams to integrate CV solutions into broader systems.
Document research processes, experiments, and evaluation results in a structured way

Qualifications
Hands-on experience building computer vision / image recognition models using YOLO (or similar detection architectures).
Proven, real experience building offline models — from research and training through to production/edge deployment (not just notebook-level experiments).
Familiarity with cloud-based CV services such as AWS Rekognition (or equivalent), able to compare use cases against custom/offline solutions.
Understanding of basic MLOps: model versioning, performance monitoring, retraining pipelines.
Familiar with tools/frameworks: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, Docker.
Able to independently perform technical assessments (feasibility, effort, and risk) before project execution.
Nice to have: experience with edge devices (Jetson, Raspberry Pi, etc.) or mobile deployment (TFLite/CoreML).

Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
Minimum 2-5 years of hands-on experience in computer vision / machine learning.
Demonstrated portfolio or GitHub of past computer vision / object detection projects, ideally including at least one model taken to production or edge deployment.
Solid understanding of mathematics relevant to computer vision (linear algebra, probability, optimization).
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to independently judge project feasibility, effort, and risk.
Good communication skills, able to explain technical trade-offs (offline vs. cloud-based) to non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams.
Willing to work on-site/hybrid as needed for hardware testing and edge-device deployment (adjust based on company policy).

title: AI Specialist
description_text:
AI Specialist

Kualifikasi:
DOODEX is a leading IT firm specializing in ERP System. We are dedicated to delivering innovative solutions to our clients worldwide. As we continue to expand our operations, we are seeking talented and dynamic individuals to join our team as Bilingual Business Analysts.

Mission:
Design, build, test, and continuously improve AI agents that work on top of Odoo for Doodex and our clients.
You will be the bridge between Odoo and AI, with your primary focus on AI. You will translate real business needs across sales, marketing, project management, and support into reliable AI agents that can work with real Odoo data. You will also help keep Doodex ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape by evaluating new AI models, tools, and technologies and recommending solutions that can create real business value.

1. Build AI Agents
Design and develop AI agents that can read and write Odoo data, including CRM, Sales, Project, Knowledge, Inventory, and Manufacturing.
Integrate agents with Odoo through XML-RPC, JSON-RPC, REST APIs, or other appropriate interfaces.
Design prompts, tools, skills, and agent workflows using technologies such as n8n, Claude, MCP servers, and other agent frameworks.
Connect AI agents with the systems used by Doodex and its clients, including Odoo, Slack, Gmail, Google Drive, and web services.
Build solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and practical for real-world business use.

2. Test, Evaluate, and Optimize Agents

Create test cases and evaluate every AI agent against realistic business scenarios before deployment.
Measure quality, accuracy, speed, reliability, and cost instead of relying on assumptions.
Identify and fix errors, hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, and workflow failures.
Monitor agents in production and continuously improve their performance.
Establish evaluation methods and benchmarks to track agent quality over time.

3. Deploy and Run Local AI
Deploy and manage open-source AI models on Doodex infrastructure using technologies such as Ollama, vLLM, or llama.cpp.
Evaluate and select the appropriate model for each use case, balancing quality, cost, speed, and data privacy.
Understand basic GPU requirements and optimize local model deployment where necessary.
Build and maintain local RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems for searching and working with internal documents and Odoo data.

4. Technology Watch
Follow new AI models, agent frameworks, developer tools, and AI technologies on a regular basis.
Evaluate which developments are relevant to Doodex and its clients.
Prepare a short monthly update for the team covering:
What is new
What is relevant to Doodex
What we should consider adopting
Potential business opportunities

5. Propose and Develop New AI Solutions
Identify repetitive or time-consuming tasks at Doodex and client organizations that could be automated with AI.
Build quick prototypes to validate ideas before investing in full development.
Present proposed solutions with a clear business case, expected benefits, and implementation approach.
Document each AI agent and solution so other team members can understand, use, and maintain it.

Requirements:
2+ years of hands-on experience working with LLMs and AI agents, preferably with projects that have been deployed or used in production.
Strong Python programming skills.
Comfortable working with REST/JSON APIs and Linux servers.
Practical experience with at least one major LLM API, such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Google Gemini.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering, tool use, RAG, and AI agent workflows.
Experience running open-source AI models locally using Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, or similar technologies.
Basic understanding of GPU infrastructure and model deployment.
Basic knowledge of Odoo, or strong willingness and ability to learn Odoo quickly, including its data model, ORM, and XML-RPC/JSON-RPC interfaces.
A strong testing and evaluation mindset — you measure results rather than simply assuming an AI solution works.
Good written English and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.
Curious, self-driven, and genuinely interested in following developments in AI.

Nice to Have
Experience with Odoo development, including Python modules and Odoo 17+.
Experience with n8n, Make, or similar automation platforms.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude Code, or AI agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
Experience with Docker.
Experience with vector databases such as pgvector or Qdrant.
Experience with fine-tuning, model evaluation, or working with small/local models.
Experience integrating AI solutions with business applications or ERP systems.

Kami mencari orang yang bukan sekadar "bisa pakai tools AI", tapi membangun karya nyata dengan AI setiap hari: coding, video, gambar, dan campaign.

Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab:
1. Merancang, membangun, dan memelihara aplikasi web dan mobile end-to-end: frontend, backend/API, database, deployment.
2. Mengintegrasikan LLM dan model AI ke dalam produk (chatbot CS, auto-reply WhatsApp, rekomendasi, OCR/ekstraksi dokumen, agent workflow) menggunakan API Anthropic/OpenAI/Google atau model open-source.

5. Mengelola infrastruktur dan CI/CD sederhana (cloud hosting, container, monitoring, backup) dan menjaga uptime layanan yang dipakai outlet dan klien setiap hari.
6. Menyusun dokumentasi teknis, arsitektur, dan API agar produk bisa dikembangkan tim lain.
7. Menjadi partner teknis tim creative dan marketing: membuat tool internal, automasi (n8n/Make/Zapier atau custom), dan integrasi data.

Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 jurusan Sistem Informasi, Teknik Informatika, Teknologi Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak, Teknik Komputer, atau jurusan relevan lainnya. Semester akhir yang sedang skripsi diperbolehkan untuk melamar.

Terbiasa bekerja dengan AI coding assistant dan mampu menjelaskan kapan output AI boleh dipakai apa adanya dan kapan harus ditulis ulang.
Git, code review, testing dasar, deployment ke cloud (Vercel, GCP, AWS, atau VPS).
Bahasa Inggris teknis (dokumentasi, library, komunitas) dan komunikasi kerja dalam bahasa Indonesia.
Builder mentality: terbiasa menghasilkan karya nyata dengan AI, bukan hanya mengikuti tren. Portofolio lebih penting dari gelar.
Belajar cepat: tools AI berganti tiap beberapa bulan; kami butuh orang yang nyaman mencoba, gagal, dan mengulang.
Kolaboratif lintas fungsi: nyaman bekerja langsung dengan operasional outlet, tim marketing, dan direksi.

description_text:
About This Position

We are looking for a Data Analyst to support the Demand Planning team in improving demand forecast accuracy and reliability. You will analyze sales and demand patterns, develop forecasting logic, and build automated tools and monitoring to support inventory and fulfillment decisions, ensuring customer demand is met just-in-time.

If you enjoy turning data into practical forecasting solutions and working cross-functionally to improve product availability, we would love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

- Demand Forecasting & Business Analysis

- Analyze demand patterns across SKU, hub, category, time period, campaign, price changes, and seasonal/festive events.

- Develop, evaluate, and improve demand forecasting logic, including baseline normalization, seasonality, festive events

- Monitor and analyze forecast-performance metrics

- Identify and investigate sales and demand anomalies, including unusual spikes or drops caused by festive events, trends, pricing changes, or operational disruption.

- Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for Demand Planners and Supply Chain stakeholders.

- Forecasting Logic, Automation & Data Products

- Translate Demand Planning business requirements into scalable data solutions, including datasets, forecasting logic, dashboards, alerts, and automated workflows.

- Build and maintain data models and pipelines supporting demand forecasting processes, including data preparation, normalization, imputation, reporting, and configuration management.

- Automate manual forecasting and monitoring processes using SQL, Python, BigQuery, workflow orchestration/DAGs, and integrations with Google Sheets or reporting tools.

- Develop alerts and trackers to enable timely responses to changes in demand, pricing, anomalies, campaign performance, and availability risk.

- Maintain clear documentation for technical logic, data lineage, source tables, configurations, business rules, and operational runbooks.

- Production Pipeline Ownership & Reliability

- Ensure the reliability and timeliness of daily forecasting pipelines and report-refresh processes.

- Conduct troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and remediation for data-quality issues, pipeline failures, reporting discrepancies, and forecast anomalies.

- Perform manual runs or backfills when required, ensuring workflow sequence and dependencies are executed correctly.

- Work with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to improve the robustness, scalability, and maintainability of forecasting systems.

Kualifikasi:
Must Have

- Minimum 1–3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Analytics Engineer, Supply Chain Analyst, or in a similar role.

- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets, preferably in BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.

- Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and/or pipeline development.

- Understanding of demand forecasting concepts and evaluation metrics, including baseline, seasonality, outliers, trends, and forecast accuracy metrics.

- Experience building dashboards, automated reports, data pipelines, monitoring tools, or alerts.

- Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and data-validation skills.

- Ability to communicate technical analysis and insights clearly to non-technical business stakeholders.

- High ownership, strong attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple dependencies.

Preferred Qualifications

- Having backgrounds in e-commerce, retail, quick commerce, FMCG, or supply chain related fields.

- Familiar with Airflow/Composer, Git, Google Data Studio, Apache Superset, Google Cloud Platform, or similar tools.

- Exposure to machine-learning forecasting workflows or collaboration with Data Science teams.

- Experience operating and maintaining production data pipelines, including incident handling and backfill processes.

Perusahaan berkomitmen untuk mendukung transformasi digital melalui pengembangan perangkat lunak, layanan implementasi, integrasi sistem, serta dukungan teknis yang profesional. Dengan pengalaman dalam pengembangan solusi digital, khususnya di sektor kesehatan, PT Sintesa Persada Teknologi menghadirkan berbagai produk dan layanan yang membantu fasilitas pelayanan kesehatan, institusi, dan mitra bisnis dalam meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, kualitas layanan, serta pengelolaan data secara aman dan sesuai dengan regulasi yang berlaku. System Analyst bertanggung jawab untuk menganalisis kebutuhan bisnis dan mengidentifikasi solusi teknologi yang sesuai. Posisi ini melibatkan komunikasi langsung dengan stakeholder untuk memahami kebutuhan pengguna dan mengubahnya menjadi spesifikasi sistem yang jelas. Tugas-tugas utama mencakup analisis kebutuhan, pengembangan skema sistem, pengujian, dan pemantauan implementasi sistem.

Kami mencari kandidat dengan gelar sarjana (S1) dalam bidang informatika, teknik komputer, atau disiplin ilmu terkait. Kandidat harus memiliki keterampilan dalam layanan pelanggan, analisis bisnis, siklus pengembangan perangkat lunak (SDLC), analisis sistem, kerja tim, manajemen stakeholder, UML, analisis kebutuhan, Microsoft Office, dan dokumentasi perangkat lunak. Kami mencari individu yang memiliki antusiasme terhadap inovasi, kemampuan berpikir analitis, serta kemampuan komunikasi yang baik untuk berkontribusi dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan kolaboratif.

title: Data Platform Engineer
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
About this Position

As a Data Platform Engineer — External Data Acquisition, you will build and operate ASTRO's platform for acquiring data from external sources, including websites, web/mobile applications, APIs, public datasets, and third-party data providers.

A significant part of this role focuses on production-grade web and application data acquisition for pricing and market intelligence use cases. You will own the acquisition layer—from understanding external systems and extracting data to delivering reliable landing data for downstream processing.

Focus: External Data Acquisition · Web & App Scraping · Python · HTTP/API · Data Pipelines · Reliability

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Build and maintain reliable web/app crawlers, scrapers, and external API integrations across e-commerce, marketplace, retail, and other external sources.

- Analyze browser, mobile application, API, and network traffic to understand how data is delivered and design the appropriate acquisition approach and runtime, from direct HTTP/API extraction to browser automation.

- Build acquisition systems that remain reliable as external websites, applications, APIs, and data contracts evolve.

- Handle real-world source complexity such as sessions, tokens, pagination, dynamic content, rate limits, retries, concurrency, and partial failures.

- Build resilient and maintainable acquisition systems with appropriate testing, idempotency, deduplication, retries, safe reruns, data-quality validation, monitoring, and alerting.

- Operate acquisition workloads using appropriate workflow orchestration, compute, data storage/warehousing, and cloud infrastructure.

- Continuously improve reliability, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership, including evaluating build-vs-buy approaches for external data.

- Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development or automation to improve how external-data pipelines are built, operated, and maintained.

- Collaborate with Pricing, Data Warehouse Engineering, Data Analysts, and other stakeholders to turn external-data needs into sustainable platform capabilities.

Kualifikasi:
In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

- Strong Python/software engineering fundamentals and experience building maintainable production systems.

- Hands-on experience building or operating web scraping, crawling, external API, or similar data acquisition systems.

- Strong understanding of HTTP, APIs, JSON, headers, cookies, sessions, authentication, pagination, and request/response behavior.

- Hands-on experience with browser/network debugging and the ability to investigate how websites or applications communicate with their backend services.

- Experience with both HTTP-based extraction and browser automation, using tools such as Requests/HTTPX, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy, or equivalent.

- Understanding of production reliability patterns such as retry, timeout, rate limiting, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.

- Solid understanding of SQL, data storage/warehousing, schema evolution, workflow orchestration, containerized workloads, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.

- Strong troubleshooting skills, especially when working with frequently changing external systems outside your direct control.

Good to Have

- Experience acquiring data from mobile applications, marketplaces, e-commerce, grocery, food-delivery, or other large consumer platforms.

- Experience with asynchronous or distributed acquisition systems and high-volume crawling.

- Familiarity with proxy infrastructure, data observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.

- Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve data acquisition workflows.

- Experience designing reusable scraping frameworks or shared acquisition platforms.

- Experience with geospatial or other non-traditional external datasets.

title: Senior Android Engineer
location: Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, DKI Jakarta
description_text:
About this Position

This role focuses on building and optimizing high-performance Android applications that deliver smooth, responsive, and seamless user experiences. You will collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to develop new features, improve application performance, and deliver fluid UI transitions and animations comparable to leading quick-commerce applications such as Blinkit and Zepto. You will also take ownership of performance profiling, troubleshooting, and optimization across app startup time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering. Additionally, you will explore and leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows.

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

- Lead the development, optimization, and maintenance of Android applications, ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, and code quality.

- Identify, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks related to app startup time, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering.

- Implement smooth UI transitions, animations, gestures, and micro-interactions to deliver a responsive and seamless user experience comparable to Blinkit and Zepto.

- Profile and optimize Android rendering performance, scrolling behavior, frame rendering time, and main-thread execution to minimize UI jank and frozen frames.

- Collaborate with Product and Design teams to translate UI/UX requirements into polished, high-performance Android experiences.

- Establish performance benchmarks, monitor production metrics, and continuously improve application responsiveness and resource efficiency.

- Lead technical design discussions, break down complex engineering problems into actionable tasks, and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery.

- Perform code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices in Android development, performance optimization, testing, and maintainable architecture.

- Take ownership of the full product lifecycle, including development, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.

- Explore and leverage AI tools or technologies to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows, including coding, debugging, refactoring, test generation, and documentation.

- Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and performance before integrating them into production applications.

Kualifikasi:
In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

- Minimum 3-4 years of experience in software engineering, with strong hands-on experience in native Android application development.

- Strong proficiency in Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development practices.

- Solid experience with Jetpack Compose and/or the Android View system, including advanced UI rendering, animations, transitions, and gesture handling.

- Proven experience identifying and resolving Android performance issues related to application startup, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, frame rendering time, and memory consumption.

- Hands-on experience with performance profiling and debugging tools such as Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Android GPU Inspector, Firebase Performance, and LeakCanary.

- Strong understanding of Android's rendering pipeline, frame deadlines, VSync, main-thread execution, garbage collection, memory allocation, and CPU/GPU utilization.

- Proven ability to build smooth, responsive UI experiences, including complex animations, seamless navigation transitions, optimized scrolling, skeleton loading states, and interactive components.

- Experience optimizing lists, image loading, caching, asynchronous processing, and background operations using technologies such as RecyclerView, Kotlin Coroutines, and Flow.

- Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns, including MVVM or MVI, dependency injection, modularization, and clean code principles.

- Experience with application performance monitoring, benchmarking, production troubleshooting, and regression prevention.

- Practical experience exploring and using AI-powered development tools to improve coding productivity, debugging, testing, refactoring, and other everyday engineering workflows.

- Ability to validate AI-assisted implementations and ensure that generated solutions meet production standards for performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.

- Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, CI/CD, release management, production monitoring, and maintenance.

- Possesses a curious and proactive mindset, continuously seeking feedback, learning new technologies, and exploring better engineering practices to improve application performance and development efficiency.

title: Software Engineer
description_text:
About SMS Perkasa

We're an innovative steel and building materials distributor based in Surabaya, transforming how the industry operates through technology. While others in the steel trade rely on spreadsheets and phone calls, we build software that gives us — and our customers — a real edge. 🏗️

The Role

You won't just write code here. You'll steer AI agents that write code, then make sure it's actually good. We use AI coding tools daily — not as novelties, but as core parts of how we ship software. Your job is to define the problem clearly, direct AI to build the solution, review every line it produces, and own what goes to production. 🤖

If that sounds like managing a small engineering team rather than being a solo coder — you're getting the idea. 🎯

What You'll Do

- Break down business problems into clear specs and architectural prompts that guide AI agents toward correct solutions

- Direct AI coding tools to generate, test, and iterate on code across our systems — from internal platforms to customer-facing products

- Design system architecture — APIs, databases, integrations — and make decisions that hold up as we scale

- Own features end-to-end: from understanding the business need, through implementation, to production deployment

- Write tests that keep AI agents (and yourself) honest. Strong test coverage is how you move fast without breaking things

- Collaborate directly with our team to translate real operational challenges in the steel industry into working software

What We Offer

We're a young team that builds things that matter — tools that impact how steel and building materials move across Indonesia. You'll have real freedom to explore ideas and make your own decisions. No one here is going to micromanage you. 💡

Come with your bright ideas. Speak up. Challenge assumptions. That's how we work. 🗣️

We invest seriously in learning — new tools, new skills, personal growth. You'll never stop getting better here. And you'll be part of a team that genuinely values your contributions and has fun doing the work. 📚

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, because that's what good people deserve. ⚖️

Kualifikasi:
Must-Have Skills:

- Solid engineering fundamentals — You know what good code looks like. Data structures, design patterns, debugging. You need this to catch what AI gets wrong

- System design thinking — You can reason about how pieces fit together: APIs, databases, third-party integrations, deployment

- AI coding tool experience — You've used Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to build real software — not just experimented with them

- Disciplined code review — You treat AI-generated code like a PR from an eager but sometimes careless junior engineer

- Problem decomposition — You can take a vague business request and turn it into a series of concrete, buildable tasks

- Testing instinct — You write tests not because someone told you to, but because you've seen what happens when you don't

Nice to have:

- Experience with TypeScript, Javascript, or Python

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

- Background in ERP systems, supply chain, or logistics software

- Experience building internal tools or B2B products

- Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio we can look at

Digital Marketing

Kualifikasi:
PT Global Asia Wijaya adalah perusahaan distribusi alat kesehatan yang berfokus pada penyediaan solusi implant, instrumen bedah, power tools, dan produk diagnostik berkualitas tinggi untuk mendukung pelayanan kesehatan di Indonesia. Didirikan pada tahun 2021 dan beroperasi dengan merek dagang Asiaway, perusahaan berkomitmen menghadirkan produk yang aman, inovatif, dan sesuai dengan standar regulasi yang berlaku. Dengan pengalaman lebih dari 17 tahun di industri alat kesehatan dan ortopedi, PT Global Asia Wijaya didukung oleh tim profesional yang berpengalaman dalam bidang pemasaran, distribusi, registrasi produk, serta layanan purna jual. Perusahaan menjunjung tinggi prinsip Good Corporate Governance (GCG), integritas, kualitas, dan keberlanjutan dalam setiap aspek operasionalnya. Sebagai mitra terpercaya bagi rumah sakit, klinik, dan tenaga kesehatan, PT Global Asia Wijaya terus mengembangkan portofolio produk inovatif untuk berbagai spesialisasi medis, khususnya ortopedi dan bedah. Melalui jaringan distribusi yang luas dan layanan yang responsif, perusahaan berkomitmen memberikan solusi kesehatan yang efektif, aman, dan bernilai tambah bagi masyarakat Indonesia. Kami sedang mencari seorang Digital Marketing Specialist yang memiliki semangat untuk berkembang bersama kami dan berkontribusi dalam memperluas jangkauan merek kami di pasar digital.

Sebagai Digital Marketing Specialist, Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas strategi pemasaran digital perusahaan, termasuk pengelolaan kampanye media sosial, optimasi mesin pencari, dan pengembangan konten yang menarik. Anda akan bekerja sama dengan tim pemasaran untuk merancang dan melaksanakan kampanye yang efektif, mengelola akun media sosial seperti TikTok, Instagram, dan Facebook, serta memastikan konsistensi pesan merek. Selain itu, Anda juga akan bertanggung jawab atas analisis data pemasaran digital menggunakan Google Analytics, mengoptimalkan iklan berbayar melalui Google Ads, dan membuat desain grafis sederhana untuk pendukung konten. Tugas utama Anda adalah meningkatkan visibilitas merek, menghasilkan leads, dan meningkatkan konversi melalui berbagai saluran digital. Anda akan menjadi bagian penting dari tim yang berkomitmen untuk menciptakan dampak nyata dalam dunia kesehatan melalui inovasi dan komunikasi yang efektif.

Kami mencari kandidat yang memiliki latar belakang pendidikan SMA/SMK dan memiliki pengalaman antara 1 hingga 3 tahun dalam bidang pemasaran digital. Kandidat harus memiliki kemampuan dalam komunikasi pemasaran, pemasaran B2B, pemasaran digital, penggunaan TikTok, media sosial, Google Ads, Google Analytics, pengeditan gambar, pemasaran konten, dan strategi konten. Kemampuan berpikir kreatif, mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim, serta memiliki antusiasme terhadap dunia digital adalah nilai tambah. Jika Anda memiliki minat kuat dalam pemasaran digital dan ingin bergabung dengan tim yang dinamis dan berkomitmen, kami sangat menantikan aplikasi Anda.

Digital Marketing & E Commerce Specialist

Kualifikasi:
Job Description

We are looking for a Digital Ads & E-Commerce Specialist to manage and optimize our paid media and e-commerce operations across multiple platforms. This role will be responsible for driving traffic, improving conversions, maximizing campaign performance, and ensuring smooth execution of e-commerce initiatives. The ideal candidate understands both performance marketing and marketplace operations, and is able to work closely with creative and KOL teams to support business growth.

Key Responsibilities
Manage and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Shopee Ads, and other relevant digital advertising platforms.
Plan, execute, monitor, and improve campaigns across the full funnel, from awareness, consideration, conversion, to retargeting.
Oversee creative rotation and creative boosting strategy to maintain ad freshness and improve campaign performance.

Analyze campaign results regularly, including spend, ROAS, CTR, CPA, conversion rate, and other key performance metrics.
Collaborate closely with the Creative Team and KOL Specialist to brief, request, and align on creative assets needed for ads and campaign execution.

Monitor marketplace performance and recommend strategies to improve product visibility, traffic, conversion, and sales.
Work closely with internal teams to align advertising strategies with brand objectives, product priorities, and sales targets.
Stay updated with platform trends, algorithm changes, ad features, and e-commerce campaign opportunities to keep the brand competitive.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. Fresh graduates are welcomed.
Strong understanding of Meta, TikTok, and Shopee Ads, and marketplace campaign mechanics.
Familiar with performance metrics such as ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPA, CAC, and conversion rate.
Able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and coordination skills for cross-functional collaboration.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and highly organized.

title: Social Media Specialist / Content Creator
description_text:
Social Media Specialist / Content Creator

Kualifikasi:
## Tentang Kami

Syakura Student Living merupakan hunian mahasiswa yang hadir dengan konsep modern, nyaman, dan terintegrasi di kawasan pendidikan. Untuk area Bogor, Syakura Student Living berfokus pada pengembangan hunian mahasiswa di sekitar IPB Dramaga sekaligus membangun ekosistem dan komunitas yang aktif.

Saat ini kami mencari **Content Creator / Social Media Specialist** yang kreatif, adaptif terhadap tren, memahami karakter audiens mahasiswa, serta mampu mengembangkan media sosial sebagai salah satu kanal utama untuk meningkatkan **brand awareness, engagement, leads, dan mendukung pemasaran properti Syakura Student Living Bogor.**

## Tanggung Jawab Utama

* Membuat ide, konsep, dan eksekusi konten kreatif untuk Instagram, TikTok, dan platform digital lainnya.
* Membuat konten dalam bentuk foto, video, Reels, TikTok, Story, serta konten informatif dan promotional.
* Menyusun dan mengelola content plan serta kalender konten mingguan dan bulanan.
* Melakukan riset tren, kompetitor, serta perilaku audiens mahasiswa dan pasar properti.
* Mengembangkan content pillar dan karakter komunikasi Syakura Student Living Bogor secara konsisten.
* Melakukan proses produksi konten secara end-to-end, mulai dari ide, script, shooting, editing hingga publikasi.
* Mendokumentasikan aktivitas penghuni, fasilitas, event, kawasan, progres properti, dan kegiatan marketing.
* Mengelola akun media sosial serta menjaga interaksi dengan audiens.
* Membuat copywriting dan caption yang menarik serta sesuai dengan tone of voice Syakura.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim Marketing, Sales, Property Management, dan Creative dalam menjalankan campaign.
* Membantu pengembangan strategi KOL, influencer, mahasiswa, komunitas kampus, dan talent untuk kebutuhan konten.
* Membuat brief serta mengoordinasikan kebutuhan konten bersama talent/KOL.
* Mengikuti dan mengadaptasi tren media sosial yang relevan tanpa menghilangkan identitas brand.
* Menganalisis performa konten berdasarkan reach, views, engagement, follower growth, leads, dan conversion.
* Memberikan rekomendasi serta melakukan optimasi berdasarkan hasil performa konten.
* Membuat laporan performa media sosial secara berkala.

## Kualifikasi

* Pendidikan minimal minimal SMA/SMK sederajat, Marketing, Desain, Multimedia, atau bidang relevan.
* Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Content Creator / Social Media Specialist menjadi nilai tambah.
* Memahami Instagram, TikTok, Reels, dan perkembangan tren media sosial.
* Terbiasa membuat konten secara end-to-end.
* Mampu melakukan riset ide dan trend hunting.
* Mampu melakukan shooting foto/video menggunakan smartphone maupun kamera.
* Menguasai aplikasi editing seperti **CapCut, Canva**, atau software sejenis.
* Memiliki kemampuan storytelling dan copywriting yang baik.
* Memiliki visual sense yang kuat terkait komposisi, warna, angle, dan estetika konten.
* Memahami dasar algoritma media sosial, engagement, prime time, hook, retention, dan CTA.
* Familiar dengan Instagram Insights, TikTok Analytics, Meta Business Suite, atau tools analytics lainnya.
* Mampu bekerja dengan timeline dan target konten mingguan maupun bulanan.
* Kreatif, komunikatif, proaktif, dan memiliki inisiatif tinggi.
* Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun bersama tim.
* Siap bekerja dengan target performa seperti engagement, audience growth, leads, dan conversion.
* Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, serta memiliki komitmen terhadap perusahaan.

## Nilai Plus

* Pernah membuat konten untuk bidang **property, hospitality, kost, lifestyle, atau student living**.
* Memahami karakter mahasiswa IPB dan lingkungan kampus Dramaga.
* Memiliki portofolio konten TikTok/Reels dengan performa yang baik.
* Memiliki pengalaman bekerja sama dengan KOL, influencer, talent, atau komunitas kampus.
* Mampu menjadi talent atau host dalam konten.
* Mampu membuat konsep campaign yang berorientasi pada awareness sekaligus menghasilkan leads.
* Memahami basic digital marketing dan advertising menjadi nilai tambah.

description_text:
Corporate Finance Analyst

Kualifikasi:
Mencari seseorang yang berkompeten dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim mereka. Kami membutuhkan Corporate Finance Analyst yang mampu memberikan analisis keuangan yang akurat dan mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis perusahaan. Posisi ini sangat penting bagi kami dalam menjaga pertumbuhan dan stabilitas finansial, serta meningkatkan efisiensi operasional. Jika Anda memiliki latar belakang di bidang keuangan dan ingin bekerja di lingkungan yang dinamis dan kreatif, inilah kesempatan yang tepat untuk Anda.

Corporate Finance Analyst bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan data keuangan, penyusunan laporan keuangan, analisis tren pemasaran, dan dukungan dalam perencanaan anggaran. Selain itu, posisi ini juga melibatkan kolaborasi dengan berbagai divisi untuk mengevaluasi kinerja keuangan dan memberikan rekomendasi strategis. Analisis yang dilakukan akan menjadi dasar bagi keputusan bisnis yang lebih baik dan berkelanjutan. Dibutuhkan kemampuan analitis yang kuat, ketelitian, serta kemampuan komunikasi yang baik untuk menyampaikan hasil analisis kepada manajemen.

Posisi ini tersedia untuk sistem kerja HYBRID. Kandidat harus memiliki gelar S1 dari jurusan terkait seperti Ekonomi, Akuntansi, atau Manajemen. Pengalaman kerja minimal 1 hingga 3 tahun di bidang keuangan atau analisis data akan menjadi nilai tambah. Kandidat harus memiliki keterampilan dalam layanan pelanggan, kerja sama tim, penggunaan Microsoft Excel, keterampilan analitis, SQL, kemampuan berbicara di depan umum, serta pemahaman dasar tentang Microsoft Word, Microsoft Office, dan administrasi. Kami mencari individu yang proaktif, mampu bekerja mandiri maupun dalam tim, dan siap berkontribusi pada pertumbuhan perusahaan.

description_text:
Finance, Accounting & Tax

Kualifikasi:
Finance, Accounting & Tax (Untuk Brand; Nice Kids, Nice Belle, Nice Label & AEGI)

JOB DESK

FINANCE
Melaksanakan pencatatan seluruh transaksi keuangan perusahaan secara akurat dan tepat waktu.
Mengelola kas masuk, kas keluar, serta petty cash sesuai prosedur yang ditetapkan.
Menyiapkan, memverifikasi, dan memproses pembayaran kepada vendor/supplier berdasarkan dokumen pendukung yang sah.
Menyusun dan mengirim invoice kepada pelanggan serta melakukan pemantauan terhadap piutang yang jatuh tempo.
Melakukan rekonsiliasi bank secara berkala untuk memastikan kesesuaian saldo dan transaksi.
Mengelola pengarsipan dokumen keuangan secara sistematis dan sesuai standar audit.
Menyusun laporan keuangan dasar dan laporan arus kas sebagai bahan evaluasi manajemen.
Mendukung proses audit internal maupun eksternal dengan menyediakan data dan dokumen yang diperlukan.
Memastikan seluruh proses keuangan dilaksanakan sesuai kebijakan perusahaan dan ketentuan peraturan yang berlaku.

ACCOUNTING
Melakukan pencatatan transaksi-transaksi harian (penjualan, pembelian, biaya, kas, kas bank, dll)
Menyusun laporan keuangan bulanan dan tahunan (Laba rugi dan Neraca).
Mengelola akun hutang (AP) dan piutang (AR), termasuk validasi invoice, faktur pajak, dan penjadwalan pembayaran di lakukan tepat waktu.
Memantau dan memperbarui kas kecil, transaksi bank, dan laporan arus kas.
Mendukung proses audit dengan menyiapkan dokumen-dokumen yang diperlukan.
Membantu penyusunan anggaran dan pengendalian biaya, terutama untuk stok barang dan operasional toko.

TAX:
Menghitung dan memastikan pelaporan pajak bulanan dan tahunan dilakukan tepat waktu (PPN, PPh 21, PPh 23, dll).
Menyimpan dokumen pajak dengan rapi dan melakukan e-filing melalui DJP Online.
Berkoordinasi dengan konsultan pajak jika diperlukan, khususnya untuk update regulasi pemerintah atau pemeriksaan pajak.
Memastikan seluruh praktik perusahaan sesuai dan dapat di pertanggung jawabkan.
Memantau dan mengelola penerbitan serta pelaporan e-Faktur.

JOB REQ

Min. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau Perpajakan.
Diprioritaskan lulusan dari kampus UMN, Untar, Prasmul, Binus, UPH.
Pengalaman kerja minimal 5 tahun di bidang accounting dan pajak, lebih disukai dari industri retail Online dan Offline, manufacturing, Distribusi atau FMCG.
Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel (Pivot table, Vlookup, and etc).
Mampu menggunakan software akuntansi dan pajak seperti; Accurate, Coretax, E-faktur, e-SPT, dan e-Filling.
Memahami peraturan perpajakan Indonesia dengan baik serta prosedur kepatuhannya.
Teliti, terorganisir, dan mampu bekerja dengan tenggat waktu yang ketat.
Memiliki integritas tinggi, bertanggung jawab, dan menjaga kerahasiaan data.

DI UTAMAKAN
Berpengalaman menangani pembukuan untuk perusahaan dengan multi-brand atau multi-entitas.
Memahami akuntansi untuk persediaan barang dan harga pokok penjualan.
Pernah menangani pemeriksaan pajak atau bekerja dengan konsultan pajak.
Memiliki sertifikat Brevet A dan B (Opsional tetapi jika ada menjadi point plus)
Mahir wajib bisa menggunakan Accurate & Wajib memiliki laptop pribadi

### Finance & Accounting Executive

**Jakarta, Indonesia | Full-time | Individual Contributor**

OCX is looking for a Finance & Accounting Executive to take ownership of our finance function from the ground up. As the company grows and expands across multiple countries, this role has real potential to grow into leading a team.

Expertise in accounting is required, with working competency in finance and tax.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Full-cycle accounting: AR, AP, GL, and monthly close
- Reconciliation: operating accounts and custodial wallet, plus seller payouts and refunds, across multiple currencies
- Indonesia tax compliance: Tax filing and reporting via Coretax
- Monthly reporting: P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and Project P&L on an ad-hoc basis
- Finance operations: budget tracking, vendor payments, invoicing, and expense management across teams

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have:

- 3 to 5 years hands-on accounting experience, able to run month-end close with minimal oversight
- Indonesia tax experience (VAT, PPh21, PPh23)
- Multi-currency accounting experience (IDR/SGD or similar)
- Fluent in English, written and spoken
- Detail-obsessed, with a can-do attitude and comfort taking ownership in a fast-paced startup

Nice-to-Have:

- Experience in leading a small team (< 5 people)
- Background in an audit or public accounting firm
- Experience across multiple finance functions (accounting, finance, tax) over your career
- Experience in a high-growth or early-stage startup
- Experience setting up processes or systems from scratch, rather than inheriting and following an existing one
- Marketplace, fintech, or e-commerce knowledge (escrow, custodial funds, payment gateway reconciliation)
- Regional accounting knowledge (e.g. Singapore/IRAS)

Not a Fit If:

- You need close supervision on day-to-day tasks
- You've only done bookkeeping, not full-cycle close
- You need a highly structured corporate environment to thrive
- You need clear SOPs in place before you can start working
- You wait for instructions when a situation is unclear, rather than proposing a way forward

WHY JOIN OCX

- Build OCX's finance function from the ground up, real ownership from day one
- Direct access to founders, no management layers
- As the company grows, so does the role, with a clear path to leadership

title: Risk Analyst
description_text:
Risk Analyst

Kualifikasi:
PT Oki Doki Indonesia, dengan visi "Navigating Boundaries, Connecting Worlds", adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi inovatif dalam pengelolaan risiko dan kepatuhan di berbagai sektor bisnis. Kami saat ini sedang mencari individu yang berkompeten dan bersemangat untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Semarang Barat, Semarang, Jawa Tengah. Posisi ini sangat penting bagi perkembangan perusahaan karena kami membutuhkan seseorang yang mampu mengidentifikasi, mengevaluasi, dan mengurangi risiko yang dapat memengaruhi operasional dan pertumbuhan bisnis kami. Kami menawarkan lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan peluang untuk berkembang bersama perusahaan yang terus berkembang.

Sebagai seorang Credit Analyst, posisi ini bertanggung jawab mengevaluasi kelayakan finansial, memimpin uji kelayakan customer (customer due diligence) B2B, serta mengelola peninjauan agreement terkait klausul kredit dan syarat pembayaran (terms of payment). Peran ini berfokus pada analisis laporan keuangan, verifikasi legalitas, pemeriksaan rekam jejak kredit, serta pelaksanaan background check guna menetapkan batas limit kredit (credit limit) yang aman. Selain itu, Anda akan memastikan seluruh kesepakatan fasilitas kredit tertuang secara sah dalam agreement resmi serta meminimalkan risiko piutang tak tertagih (bad debt) sejak awal proses kerja sama.

Selain penilaian di awal, Anda bertugas memantau portofolio kredit, mengelola proses validasi dan penyelesaian klaim (claim dispute reconciliation) dari customer, serta menjalankan uji kelayakan berkala. Dalam pelaksanaannya, Anda akan berkolaborasi erat dengan tim Finance, Legal, dan Sales untuk memastikan setiap klaim potongan atau selisih tagihan diproses secara akurat tanpa mengganggu arus kas perusahaan. Posisi ini menuntut ketelitian tinggi, kemampuan analisis finansial yang kuat, serta pemahaman mendalam mengenai administrasi kontrak bisnis dan manajemen risiko piutang B2B

Memiliki pengalaman dalam penyusunan laporan manajemen dan analisis keuangan.
Terbiasa melakukan improvement terhadap proses administrasi keuangan.

Disiplin terhadap deadline dan tidak menunda pekerjaan.

title: Senior Tax Officer
description_text:
Key Responsibilities

- Prepare, calculate, review, and submit monthly and annual tax returns (Corporate Income Tax, VAT, and other applicable taxes).

- Collect and organize the necessary financial and tax documents, Coordinate with clients to collect required tax data and documentation.

- Calculate the company’s tax liabilities based on the applicable tax regulations. Ensure compliance with Indonesian tax regulations and identify tax planning opportunities.

- Check the accuracy and completeness of the tax calculations, invoices, tax documents, and supporting data before submission.

- Submit the monthly and annual tax returns through the applicable tax reporting system within the required deadlines.

- Make sure that all tax reporting and payments comply with the latest Indonesian tax laws and regulations, while maintaining proper documentation for future reference or potential tax audits.

- This responsibility means that you will assist our clients when they are facing a tax audit, objection, or dispute with the tax authority.

- You will help prepare the required documents, review the tax authority’s findings, analyze the tax issues, prepare explanations or responses, and support the client in preparing an objection if they disagree with the tax assessment.

- You will also need to communicate effectively with the client and coordinate with the relevant parties to make sure the case is handled properly and in accordance with the applicable tax regulations.

- Candidate must be have a Good Leadership to Supervise and review the work of Junior and Middle Tax Officers.

Kualifikasi:
Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Tax, Accounting, or a related field.

- Minimum 2 years of experience in taxation, preferably in a Tax Consulting Firm or Public Accounting Firm.

- Strong knowledge of Indonesian tax regulations.

- Brevet A & B (Brevet C is a plus).

- USKP A & B certification is preferred.

- Proficient in tax software and Microsoft Excel.

- Willing to work in Ungasan, Badung, Bali.

Benefits

- Salary: IDR 10 - 12 million (net).

- Company-covered BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan.

- Training and professional development opportunities.

- Supportive work environment with career growth opportunities.

title: Finance,Accounting & Tax Officer
description_text:
Finance,Accounting & Tax Officer

Kualifikasi:
DESKRIPSI PEKERJAAN
FINANCE, ACCOUNTING & TAX OFFICER

1. Tujuan Jabatan
Mengelola keuangan, pencatatan akuntansi, dan kewajiban perpajakan klinik secara akurat, transparan, dan sesuai regulasi, guna mendukung kelancaran operasional serta meningkatkan profitabilitas layanan kesehatan dan estetika.

2. Tanggung Jawab Utama (Spesifik Klinik)

Mengelola seluruh transaksi keuangan klinik (poli umum, gigi, kebidanan, laboratorium, dan layanan kecantikan).
Melakukan pencatatan akuntansi harian (pemasukan treatment, obat, tindakan medis, dll).
Mengontrol arus kas (cashflow) klinik agar tetap sehat.
Mengelola pendapatan dari berbagai sumber:
(pasien umum, paket treatment, membership, laboratorium, apotek).
Menghitung dan mengelola biaya operasional:
(gaji tenaga medis, bahan medis habis pakai, obat, alat kecantikan).
Menyusun laporan keuangan (harian, mingguan, bulanan).
Mengelola kewajiban pajak klinik sesuai peraturan (PPN, PPh, dll).
Melakukan rekonsiliasi kas, bank, dan sistem (kasir vs laporan).
Mengontrol kebocoran keuangan (fraud, selisih kas, manipulasi data).

3. Tugas Harian (Operational Finance)

Input transaksi harian (treatment, obat, tindakan dokter).
Closing kas harian & pengecekan setoran kasir.
Rekap penjualan layanan (per dokter, per treatment).
Monitoring pembayaran pasien (cash, transfer, QRIS, asuransi).
Kontrol stok terkait nilai keuangan (obat, skincare, bahan treatment).
Follow up piutang (jika ada kerja sama perusahaan/asuransi).

4. Tugas Accounting (Spesifik Klinik & Beauty)

Menyusun laporan:
Laporan laba rugi per layanan (kesehatan & estetika)
Laporan omzet treatment kecantikan
Laporan biaya operasional klinik
Menghitung HPP (Harga Pokok Penjualan) treatment & produk skincare.
Menganalisis profit tiap layanan (facial, laser, filler, dll).
Melakukan pencatatan aset (alat medis & alat kecantikan).
Membuat laporan keuangan untuk manajemen dan owner.

5. Tugas Perpajakan (Tax)

Menghitung dan melaporkan pajak klinik:
PPh 21 (karyawan & tenaga medis)
PPh 23 (jasa/vendor)
PPh Final
PPN (jika ada layanan/produk kena pajak)
Membuat dan melaporkan SPT Masa & Tahunan.
Memastikan kepatuhan pajak sesuai regulasi klinik kesehatan.
Menyiapkan dokumen untuk audit pajak (jika diperlukan).

6. Kualifikasi

Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi/Keuangan/Perpajakan.
Tidak Sedang Kuliah / Sekolah
Pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun Finance , Accounting & Tax (diutamakan klinik/RS/beauty clinic).
Memahami Siklus akuntansi hingga penyusunan Laporan Keuangan
Menguasai Perpajakan Perusahaan
Memahami sistem keuangan klinik & layanan estetika.
Menguasai software akuntansi & Excel ( Pivot Table ,VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP,IF,SUMIFS,DLL )
Mampu mengoprasikan software akuntansi ( Accurate,Jurnal, Atau sejenisnya )
Teliti,jujur,bertanggung Jawab dan memiliki integritas tinggi
Memahami regulasi perpajakan Indonesia.

7. Skill Wajib

Financial reporting & cashflow management
Accounting (jurnal, neraca, laba rugi)
Perpajakan (PPh, PPN)
Analisa profit layanan klinik
Ketelitian tinggi & anti fraud
Penguasaan Excel & sistem POS klinik

8. KPI (Indikator Kinerja Utama)

Akurasi laporan keuangan (%)
Ketepatan waktu pelaporan keuangan & pajak
Cashflow klinik stabil & sehat
Minim selisih kas / fraud
Profit margin layanan meningkat
Kontrol biaya operasional (efisiensi)

9. Wewenang

Mengontrol dan memverifikasi transaksi keuangan
Menolak transaksi yang tidak sesuai prosedur
Memberikan rekomendasi efisiensi biaya
Mengakses data keuangan klinik secara penuh

10. Hubungan Kerja

Internal: Owner, manajemen, dokter, apoteker, admin, kasir
Eksternal: Konsultan pajak, bank, auditor, vendor

11. Fokus Khusus Klinik Kecantikan

Mengontrol pendapatan treatment (high margin seperti laser, filler, dll).
Analisa profit paket bundling & promo kecantikan.
Monitoring penjualan skincare & produk estetika.
Menghitung komisi dokter/therapist berdasarkan tindakan.
Mengontrol biaya bahan treatment agar tidak overuse.

12. Risiko yang Harus Dikontrol

Selisih kas harian
Fraud dari transaksi manual
Overclaim penggunaan bahan treatment
Ketidaksesuaian laporan vs real transaksi
Keterlambatan pelaporan pajak

description_text:
Internal Auditor (Finance, Accounting, Tax, and Inventory)

Kualifikasi:
Bergabunglah Bersama Kami!
Kami sedang mencari Internal Auditor (Inventory & Finance, Accounting & Tax) yang teliti, analitis, dan memiliki integritas tinggi untuk membantu memastikan proses operasional perusahaan berjalan dengan baik.

Pada posisi ini, Anda akan melakukan review terhadap proses inventory serta Finance, Accounting & Tax, mengidentifikasi potensi kesalahan atau risiko, dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan agar proses kerja menjadi lebih akurat, efektif, dan sesuai dengan standar perusahaan.

Jika Anda menyukai pekerjaan yang membutuhkan ketelitian, analisis, dan continuous improvement, kami mengundang Anda untuk bergabung dan berkembang bersama kami.

Tanggung Jawab Utama
Audit Internal & Kepatuhan
- Melaksanakan audit internal secara berkala pada proses Inventory serta Finance, Accounting & Tax (FAT).
- Memastikan seluruh aktivitas operasional telah sesuai dengan SOP, kebijakan perusahaan, dan pengendalian internal yang berlaku.
- Mengidentifikasi kesalahan, ketidaksesuaian, potensi risiko, serta peluang perbaikan proses.
- Memastikan tindak lanjut atas hasil audit telah dilaksanakan dengan baik oleh departemen terkait.

Audit Inventory
- Melakukan pemeriksaan dan verifikasi terhadap stok fisik serta data persediaan di sistem.
- Meninjau proses keluar masuk barang serta memastikan pencatatan inventory telah dilakukan secara akurat.
- Mengidentifikasi selisih stok dan melakukan analisis penyebabnya.
- Memberikan rekomendasi untuk meningkatkan akurasi dan efektivitas pengendalian persediaan.

Audit Finance, Accounting & Tax
- Melakukan pemeriksaan terhadap transaksi keuangan, pencatatan akuntansi, serta dokumen pendukung.
- Memastikan kelengkapan, keakuratan, dan konsistensi data keuangan serta perpajakan.
- Mengidentifikasi kesalahan input, ketidaksesuaian data, maupun potensi risiko dalam proses Finance, Accounting & Tax.
- Mendukung peningkatan kualitas proses pelaporan keuangan dan perpajakan.

Pelaporan & Perbaikan Proses
- Menyusun laporan hasil audit beserta rekomendasi perbaikan kepada Management.
- Memantau implementasi tindakan perbaikan atas temuan audit.
- Berpartisipasi dalam penyusunan maupun penyempurnaan SOP, checklist, dan standar kerja.
- Memberikan masukan untuk meningkatkan efektivitas proses bisnis, akurasi data, dan pengendalian internal.

Persyaratan
Kualifikasi
- Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, Perpajakan, Manajemen, Teknik Industri, atau jurusan lain yang relevan.
- Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar.
- Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Internal Audit, Finance, Accounting, Tax, Inventory Control, atau bidang terkait menjadi nilai tambah.

Keahlian
- Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan problem solving yang baik.
- Teliti, sistematis, dan memiliki perhatian tinggi terhadap detail.
- Memahami dasar-dasar akuntansi, perpajakan, dan pengendalian persediaan.
- Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel atau Google Sheets dengan baik.
- Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan software akuntansi atau ERP menjadi nilai tambah.
- Mampu menyusun laporan secara sistematis dan komunikatif.
- Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik.

Karakter yang Kami Cari
- Jujur, objektif, dan mampu menjaga kerahasiaan data perusahaan.
- Memiliki integritas, rasa tanggung jawab, dan ownership yang tinggi.
- Proaktif dalam mengidentifikasi masalah dan memberikan solusi.
- Memiliki keinginan untuk terus belajar dan melakukan perbaikan proses.
- Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dengan berbagai departemen.
- Berorientasi pada akurasi, kualitas kerja, dan perbaikan berkelanjutan.

Mengapa Bergabung Bersama Kami?
- Berperan langsung dalam membangun sistem pengendalian internal yang lebih baik.
- Mendapatkan pengalaman di bidang Inventory serta Finance, Accounting & Tax secara menyeluruh.
- Bekerja sama dengan Management dalam proyek standarisasi proses dan peningkatan kualitas operasional.
- Kesempatan mengembangkan kemampuan di bidang audit, analisis, dan process improvement.
- Menjadi bagian dari perusahaan yang terus berkembang dengan peluang belajar dan bertumbuh bersama.

title: Corporate Auditor
description_text:
We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented and objective Corporate Auditor to support the establishment, development and evaluation of our internal control systems across financial reporting, compliance and business operations. The Corporate Auditor will be responsible for planning and conducting internal audits, assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management and internal controls, identifying areas of weakness or potential risk, and recommending practical corrective actions and improvements.

The successful candidate will bring a systematic, independent and objective approach to reviewing our processes and controls, while working collaboratively with management and stakeholders across the organization.

Kualifikasi:
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 2-5 years of professional experience in internal audit, external audit, accounting or a related field.
• Good knowledge of accounting software, Microsoft Excel/spreadsheets and other relevant business systems.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written and verbal reporting skills.
• Professional certification such as CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CPA, ACCA or equivalent is highly desirable.
• Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Strong understanding of internal controls, risk assessment, audit processes and financial reporting.
• Ability to remain calm and professional when working under pressure and meeting tight deadlines.
• Strong analytical and numerical skills.
• Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
• Ability to assess risks objectively and develop practical solutions.
• Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with different teams.

description_text:

Kualifikasi:
Posisi ini akan ditempatkan di salah satu perusahaan kami

Tujuan Jabatan (Job Summary)
Bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan seluruh siklus sumber daya manusia (SDM) di perusahaan, mulai dari perencanaan, rekrutmen, pengembangan talenta, manajemen kinerja, penggajian & benefit, hingga hubungan industrial untuk mendukung pencapaian tujuan bisnis perusahaan secara efektif dan mematuhi regulasi ketenagakerjaan.

Tanggung Jawab Utama (Key Responsibilities)
1. Rekrutmen & Onboarding
Menyusun strategi dan mengelola proses rekrutmen end-to-end (penayangan lowongan, penyaringan, wawancara, hingga penawaran kerja).
Merancang dan menjalankan program onboarding untuk karyawan baru agar dapat beradaptasi dengan cepat.
2. Hubungan Industrial & Kepatuhan hukum
Memastikan seluruh kebijakan HR dan operasional perusahaan mematuhi Undang-Undang Ketenagakerjaan yang berlaku di Indonesia.
Mengelola Peraturan Perusahaan (PP) atau Perjanjian Kerja Bersama (PKB) serta pembaruannya.
Menangani isu kedisiplinan karyawan, tindakan korektif, pemutusan hubungan kerja (PHK), serta penyelesaian perselisihan hubungan industrial.
3. Manajemen Kinerja & Pengembangan SDM
Merancang, mengimplementasikan, dan mengevaluasi sistem manajemen kinerja (seperti KPI atau OKR).
Menganalisis kebutuhan pelatihan (Training Needs Analysis) dan menyusun program pengembangan keterampilan karyawan.
4. Kompensasi, Benefit, & Administrasi SDM
Mengawasi atau mengelola proses penggajian (payroll), BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, BPJS Kesehatan, PPh 21, dan tunjangan lainnya.
Mengelola data administrasi karyawan (kontrak kerja/PKWT & PKWTT, absensi, izin, dan cuti).
5. Budaya Perusahaan & Kesejahteraan Karyawan
Membangun keterikatan karyawan (employee engagement) melalui berbagai aktivitas dan program internal.
Menjadi jembatan komunikasi yang netral antara manajemen dan karyawan.

JOB SPECIFICATION (SPESIFIKASI JABATAN)
1. Kualifikasi Pendidikan & Pengalaman
Pendidikan minimal S1 Psikologi, Hukum, Manajemen SDM, atau bidang terkait.
Pengalaman kerja minimal 1–3 tahun di bidang Human Resources (pengalaman di posisi lead menjadi nilai tambah).
2. Pengetahuan & Keahlian Teknis (Hard Skills)
Memahami secara mendalam UU Ketenagakerjaan Indonesia (termasuk regulasi Cipta Kerja dan hubungannya dengan PKWT/PKWTT/PHK).
Menguasai proses rekrutmen, metodologi wawancara (seperti STAR Method), dan alat tes psikologi/asesmen.
Memahami struktur skala upah, sistem payroll, perhitungan PPh 21, serta operasional BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan.
Mahir menggunakan HRIS (Human Resources Information System) dan Microsoft Office (khususnya Excel untuk olah data).
3. Keterampilan Interpersonal & Sikap (Soft Skills)
Komunikasi Interpersonal & Negosiasi: Mampu berkomunikasi secara efektif di semua tingkatan organisasi.
Penyelesaian Masalah (Problem Solving): Mampu menangani konflik internal secara objektif, bijaksana, dan adil.
Kepemimpinan & Integrasi: Memiliki integritas tinggi, mampu menjaga kerahasiaan data perusahaan/karyawan, serta memimpin tim.
Empati & Kecerdasan Emosional: Mampu memahami kebutuhan karyawan dengan tetap menjaga profesionalisme bisnis.

title: HR Recruiter TikTok Live Talent
description_text:
HR Recruiter TikTok Live Talent

Kualifikasi:
Tanggung Jawab Utama:
- Melakukan pencarian aktif kandidat streamer, host live, MC, performer, dancer, creator, KOL kecil, talent TikTok, talent Instagram, dan calon talent live entertainment lainnya.
- Menggunakan TikTok, Instagram, DM, komentar, hashtag, komunitas, grup sosial media, referral, event, dan jaringan pribadi untuk mencari kandidat.
- Melakukan pendekatan langsung kepada calon talent, menjelaskan peluang kerja, mengatur jadwal interview, dan menjaga follow-up sampai kandidat datang.
- Menyusun strategi rekrutmen massal untuk kebutuhan live streaming entertainment.
- Membuat pipeline kandidat harian dan mingguan untuk posisi streamer, MC, host, dancer, makeup, wardrobe, camera operator, dan posisi pendukung live streaming.
- Melakukan screening awal kandidat berdasarkan komunikasi, kepercayaan diri, minat tampil di depan kamera, pengalaman live, pengalaman entertainment, dan kesesuaian dengan kebutuhan studio.
- Berkoordinasi dengan tim operasional dan manajemen untuk memahami tipe talent yang sedang dibutuhkan.
- Mengelola database kandidat, status follow-up, hasil interview, alasan gagal, dan sumber kandidat.
- Membuat laporan rekrutmen harian: jumlah kandidat dihubungi, jumlah respons, jumlah interview, jumlah hadir, jumlah diterima, dan jumlah onboard.
- Mengembangkan channel rekrutmen baru yang relevan dengan dunia live streaming dan entertainment.
- Menjaga komunikasi kandidat agar tidak hilang sebelum interview atau onboarding.
- Membantu membuat materi rekrutmen sederhana untuk TikTok, Instagram, poster, caption, dan pesan pendek rekrutmen.

Kualifikasi Wajib:
- Memiliki pengalaman nyata dalam rekrutmen talent, streamer, host live, creator, influencer, sales live, SPG event, performer, dancer, model, atau posisi yang dekat dengan entertainment / social media.
- Terbiasa mencari kandidat secara aktif melalui TikTok, Instagram, WhatsApp, komunitas, referral, grup online, atau channel non-tradisional lainnya.
- Tidak hanya mengandalkan job portal.
- Memahami karakter kandidat muda yang aktif di sosial media.
- Berani menghubungi kandidat secara langsung melalui DM, chat, telepon, dan follow-up berulang.
- Mampu bekerja dengan target jumlah kandidat dan target onboarding.
- Komunikatif, persuasif, cepat bergerak, dan tidak pasif.
- Terbiasa membuat database kandidat dan laporan rekrutmen.
- Siap bekerja on-site di Serpong, Tangerang Selatan.

Diutamakan:
- Pernah bekerja di TikTok Live agency, MCN, live streaming agency, talent agency, entertainment company, atau perusahaan group live.
- Pernah merekrut host / streamer / live talent dalam jumlah besar.
- Memiliki database atau jaringan talent, streamer, host, creator, dancer, performer, atau KOL kecil.
- Memahami cara kerja TikTok Live, live commerce, live entertainment, agency host, atau group live.
- Memiliki pengalaman membuat campaign rekrutmen melalui TikTok / Instagram.
- Memiliki kemampuan menilai apakah kandidat cocok untuk tampil di depan kamera.
- Pernah mencapai target rekrutmen massal dalam waktu singkat.

Yang Kami Tidak Cari:
- HR yang hanya terbiasa mengurus administrasi kantor tanpa pengalaman sourcing talent.
- Recruiter yang hanya menunggu lamaran dari job portal.
- HR yang hanya pernah merekrut staf umum, admin, office staff, teknisi, atau posisi perusahaan biasa tanpa pengalaman social media recruitment.
- Kandidat yang tidak aktif mencari kandidat sendiri.

Kompensasi:
Penghasilan bulanan sekitar Rp 5.5000.000 s/d Rp. 6.000.000, terdiri dari gaji pokok dan komisi / bonus berdasarkan hasil rekrutmen.

Untuk recruiter yang benar-benar bisa membawa banyak kandidat berkualitas dan membantu perusahaan merekrut talent live streaming secara stabil, penghasilan dapat berada di kisaran atas.

Indikator Keberhasilan:
- Jumlah kandidat talent yang berhasil dihubungi setiap hari.
- Jumlah kandidat yang hadir interview.
- Jumlah kandidat yang lolos dan mulai bekerja.
- Kualitas sumber kandidat dari TikTok, Instagram, referral, dan komunitas.
- Kecepatan follow-up kandidat.
- Kemampuan membangun pipeline rekrutmen berulang.
- Kontribusi nyata terhadap pemenuhan kebutuhan streamer, host, MC, dancer, dan talent live streaming.

Proses Seleksi
Kandidat yang lolos screening akan diminta menjelaskan:
- Channel rekrutmen yang pernah digunakan;
- Contoh talent yang pernah direkrut;
- Cara mencari kandidat dari TikTok atau Instagram;
- Jumlah kandidat yang pernah direkrut dalam satu bulan;
- Strategi untuk mendapatkan host / streamer / creator dalam jumlah besar.

Jika Anda memiliki pengalaman langsung merekrut talent untuk TikTok Live, live streaming entertainment, agency host, MCN, atau group live, kami sangat ingin berbicara dengan Anda.

description_text:
Human Resources Administartor (HR Admin)

Kualifikasi:
About Us:
Widya Erti Indonesia is focusing on the education, agriculture, and community development sector by providing learning opportunities and empowering rural marginal communities to responsibly and sustainably care for environment. WEI project areas are in Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Java, and other part of Indonesia, with the head office located in Jakarta.

Objective:
To manage daily human resources operations and general administrative tasks to ensure smooth employee lifecycles, accurate record-keeping, and reliable support for staff and management

Duties and Responsibilities:
The HR Administrator supports the daily operations of the People and Culture department by ensuring accurate record-keeping, assisting recruitment process, facilitating smooth onboarding and offboarding, assisting with supporting document for payroll, and maintaining compliance with local labour laws and Non-profit organization policies. The role acts as a primary contact for routine staff queries, requiring high discretion, empathy, and organizational skills

Key Responsibilities and Duties
Under the supervisions of People and Culture Manager, the HR Administrator include but are not limited to

Recruitment, Onboarding and Offboarding Support
• Assist with recruitment coordination by posting job vacancy, screening resumes and applications, organizing candidate interview schedules and summarizes the interview result.
• Assist in onboarding programs for new employee and completing new hire paperwork
• Facilitate orientation sessions, ensuring new staff members receive mandatory training and policy briefing
• Assist in offboarding process for employee leaving the organization including ensure the Resignation Process, Access Revocation, Asset Recovery and Exit Documentation.

Records and Data Management
• Update Staff Data both in the system (ERP) and internal databases with staff personal information, contract status updates, attendance and leave record
• Maintain accurate digital document of recruitment, including job vacancy, CV and application, interview record and selection report
• Generate routine reports on workforce metrics, such as attendance, leave balances, and headcount tracking.

Payroll and Benefits Coordination
• Compile and verify monthly attendance sheets, leave requests, and overtime data for payroll processing.
• Respond to employee inquiries regarding medical insurance, benefits administration, and compensation information
• Assist in tracking contract renewals and processing paperwork for staff transitions or offboarding.

Policy Compliance and Employee Relations
• Ensure all HR processes comply with national labour regulations and donor/-specific compliance requirements.
• Serve as a friendly and reliable first point of contact for routine staff questions and policy clarifications.
• Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all personnel data and sensitive workplace issues.

Other Tasks
 Assisting in the coordination and delivery of HR-related training programs.
 Other task requested by People and Culture Manager

Selection Criteria (Qualification):
Essential:
 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Psychology, or a related field.
 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in administrative or HR support roles; prior experience working in an NGO or non-profit environment is a strong advantage. Fresh graduate with strong organization experience are welcome.
 Understanding of Indonesian labour law and administrative regulations, including the Omnibus Law (Law No. 11 of 2020).
 Computer literacy with strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel and Word) and familiarity with HRIS or web-based HRM software or ERP
 Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English both written and verbal
 High level of integrity and ethical standard, professionalism, attention to detail, strong time-management abilities, and proven discretion when handling confidential materials.
 The ability to build strong relationships, work effectively in a multicultural environment, and show tact and sensitivity.

How to Apply:
Please send cover letter and CV describing your qualities and experiences to Recruitment Widya Erti Indonesia with “HR Administrator_Applicant Full Name” in the subject line, and please using this format for your file, Full Name_CV or Full Name_Application, (i.e. Luna Maya_CV, Luna Maya_Application).

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly
